evidence.snippet: An Ethereum L2, incubated by Coinbase and built on the open-source OP Stack. We have no plans to issue a new network token.
evidence.findingDescription: The documentation clearly defines Base as an Ethereum Layer 2 incubated by Coinbase and built on the open-source OP Stack, explicitly confirming no plans to release a network token.

evidence.findingTitle: Absence of Technical Quickstart and API Documentation
evidence.findingDescription: The provided documentation context lacks explicit quickstart guides, installation instructions, code snippets, or API references needed for immediate developer onboarding. Not enough evidence of technical API/SDK documentation in the provided text.

evidence.snippet: We’ve done this by launching permissionless fault proofs and increasing the decentralization of our contract upgrade process with a security council.
evidence.findingDescription: The text documents key security milestones including achieving Stage 1 Decentralization via permissionless fault proofs and security council governance over contract upgrades.
